from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document: its title and the nature of the administrative act."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written in the document header or metadata")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or administrative act type described in the document (e.g., '行政许可', '行政处罚', '行政强制')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
